title: HUK24
description: HUK24, Germany's largest direct insurer in the HUK-COBURG group, refreshed its corporate design around the promise "Digital. Einfach. Günstiger." with a modular digital palette: forest greens (#19291e, #293f30, #52815d, #659d74, #a0d1ac, #d2e7d8, #e9f4ed), teal-cyans (#032b33, #02424d, #018489, #02a1a5, #01dbdf, #7af4f7, #c4fcfd), and neon orange accents (#4f0c02, #7a1205, #d64202, #fe5b00, #febb2f, #fde09c, #fef1d3). Colors are taken from the brand's September 2026 corporate-design relaunch announcement.
